searchText: What's the most up to date kurtosis config for peerdas? I don't think we have any client releases that are ready for devnet 7 spec or latest devnet-6? devnet-7 adds data column sidecars by root on top of devnet-6 right? or are there some other additions? https://github.com/ethpandaops/eth-client-docker-image-builder/actions/runs/14833931736 `gbv2-8adb69c` this should work for nimbus-eth2 🙂 > or are there some other additions? it does what you mentioned earlier but doesn't do backfill for v custody, i'm writing that should be ready in another day or two. About peers who can serve columns, idk. but backfill would mostly depend on reconstruction and lesser on the peers, and peer switching https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/peerdas-devnet-7 stack overflow on grandine ``` │ │ thread 'rayon-1' has overflowed its stack │ │ fatal runtime error: stack overflow ``` this is for the supernode is this with the stack size increased? im using image `hangleang-peerdas-devnet-6`, do i need to add some flag? that should have the higher stack size, how many blobs did you run with? hmm, surprisingly 0....i gotta see where i messed up spamoor but also: sync aggregate participation is horrible with a lighthouse <> nimbus. its 2 lh and 1 nimbus, sync agg. is 66%, so if id have to guess nimbus isnt doing its sync aggr. duties are you now testing devnet 6 or devnet 7 spec? the config here: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/peerdas-devnet-7 thats not yet updated 😂 thats a placeholder ser could the placeholder be empty then? 😄 a placeholder with a valid value is not a placeholder anymore modified the example to include only valid images I have no idea if sidecars by root needs any changes on the EL side. Could someone from EL teams confirm? <@360491619402776577> <@519796549279023105> <@277500722655002624> oh we now have `@peerdas-cl `and `@peerdas-el ` as roles 🙂 Looks like a purely CL change can you pls confirm if most recent nethermind image is still `ethpandaops/nethermind:feature-peerdas` ? I’m not sure if increase stack size during compile work, but I no longer see this issue when setting the env like https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1359508533099495556/1359564189647110195 Interesting! If no blobs, there should be no task to spawn im increasing the stack size for all grandine builds yes. ill try this out what lh image are you using, is it devnet 7 compatible i think there will be major peering issues if we run pre DataColumnsByRootIdentifier images with post oh okay, i can chill I'm now using nimbus and grandine with their theoritically working devnet 7 images in the notes. So feel free to test those. ok there's not much difference for us really, we don't store columns in our database using that container, we just shoot requests using the new container, it should interop fine imo but <@498331483732312075> does grandine have a devnet 7 image ready? Yes, there is a branch https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1367506948504813688/1368909014775369778 (without validator custody) image is in the notes ok <@785811170387951616> seems like Nimbus supernode doesn't subscribe ~~all~~ most of data column subnets, or there is missing flag underneath I ran 1 each type per client the flag is `--debug-peerdas-supernode=true` ran with `supernode: true` for Nimbus supernode, so don't know what it parse into can you pass the flag externally and check in cl extra params? yeah, sure ` cl_extra_params: [--debug-peerdas-supernode=true]` did you guys add a new flag? I don't this was there since devnet 5 mate till now I've been using: ``` supernode_cmd = [ "--subscribe-all-subnets", ] ``` rip i think i've mentioned this before, probably with <@199561711278227457> tho subscribe all subnets is misleading as it subscribes to all attnets and syncnets too we don't want that calling it a debug flag also pretty bad practice imo, as this is a flag that will need to be around for a long time. Ideally you probably want to have something like `subscribe-all-data-column-subnets` I'll comment on this one, it's a way of letting us make releases with this without committing to what the exact shape will be long-term given the volatility in peerdas, no way would we do that yet Changing flags are pretty breaking change this is for devnet debug stuff breaking changes are what happens sure so, no, we're not going to commit to end-user compatibility for random peerdas devnet stuff tldr; we don't wanna remove it from debug, until say mainnet https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/997 fix because the user should be clarified that this isn't a pectra flag any update it works? it works, but no blobs included for block propose by nimbus dunno Y not just no blobs but not txs either? yes, only attestations opp! it forked out now sidecars by root do we have a grafana dashboard for hit rate of engine get blobs? (even if its for v1) https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1514 Updated Agenda for tomorrow - please review and add comments or DM me with revisions, additions, removals. <@293154341127454721> - I saw your noted and added your item. I will update it accordingly should anything come up on testing call.. On Prysm side we are still working on the new data columns by root requests design. Should be done by today or tomorrow. https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/7127 we have a working poc of validator custody plus excess column backfilling Have you had a chance to review the blob schedule spec PR? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4277 I'm hoping to merge this soonish. Maybe Friday. You can ignore the table parsing code btw.
